t7.zh: 玻璃与史莱姆双材质；9 款主题、自定义双色渐变，每 10 或 20 秒自动轮换。
t7.en: Glass and Slime materials; nine themes, custom two-color gradients and automatic cycling every 10 or 20 seconds.

t8.zh: 悬停显示图标并放大 1.1–4.0 倍；移开后恢复。空闲旋转、滚轮与双指滚动、右键拖动旋转。
t8.en: Hover reveals icons and enlarges the cube by 1.1–4.0×. Move away to restore; use idle rotation, scrolling, two-finger gestures or right-drag rotation.

t9.zh: macOS 26+ 支持原生 Clear Liquid Glass，早期系统使用磨砂回退；Windows 使用独立玻璃渲染。
t9.en: macOS 26+ supports native Clear Liquid Glass, with frosted fallbacks on earlier systems. Windows has its own glass renderer.

t10.zh: Windows 11 22H2+ 设置与快捷面板使用 Acrylic；旧系统、减少透明度与高对比度使用实色回退。尊重减少动态效果。
t10.en: Settings and quick panels use Acrylic on Windows 11 22H2+; older systems, reduced transparency and high contrast use solid fallbacks. Reduced motion is respected.

t12.zh: 六个面、每面四项，共 24 个快捷槽位；支持应用、文件夹、文件、网页和平台系统设置入口。
t12.en: Six faces with four slots each: 24 shortcuts for apps, folders, files, websites and platform system settings.

t13.zh: 拖入配置，直接点击打开，或先展开四图标面板。移除入口不会删除原文件或应用。
t13.en: Configure with drag and drop. Launch directly or expand a four-icon panel first. Removing a shortcut never deletes the original app or file.

t14.zh: 网页标题本地绘制，长标题省略并可悬停查看；不请求网络 favicon。
t14.en: Website titles are drawn locally, with ellipsis and hover tooltips for long names; no network favicon requests.

t15.zh: Windows 提供可搜索的应用选择器，支持已注册系统／Store 应用与便携 .exe。
t15.en: Windows includes a searchable application picker for registered desktop, system and Store apps, plus portable .exe files.

t17.zh: 靠近屏幕外侧约 32 逻辑像素，离开约 0.8 秒后收成 10 × 56 控制条；悬停恢复，原位置不变。
t17.en: Within about 32 logical pixels of an outer display edge, leaving for about 0.8 seconds collapses the cube into a 10 × 56 handle. Hover to restore without changing its saved position.

t18.zh: macOS 约 0.36 秒吸附、0.46 秒展开；可中断，减少动态效果时跳过空间过渡。
t18.en: macOS uses an approximately 0.36-second absorption and 0.46-second reveal; transitions can be interrupted and are skipped with reduced motion.

t19.zh: 全屏自动隐藏、屏幕四角／中央快速放置、拖动保存位置；显示器检测不读取屏幕像素。
t19.en: Fullscreen auto-hide, corner/center placement and saved dragging positions. Display detection does not read screen pixels.

t20.zh: macOS 独立调节屏幕亮度。Apple 屏幕走原生控制，外接屏幕需要 Apple Silicon 与可用 DDC/CI。
t20.en: Independent brightness on macOS: native control for Apple displays; external hardware backlight control requires Apple Silicon and usable DDC/CI.

t21.zh: 双平台 Type-C／HDMI 输入切换，按显示器保存实测代码并回读确认。硬件兼容性取决于固件、驱动和连接路径。
t21.en: Type-C/HDMI switching on both platforms, with measured codes saved per display and confirmed readback. Compatibility depends on firmware, drivers and the connection path.

t23.zh: 会话历史仅在内存中；启动后自动记录，可暂停，不导入启动前的剪贴板，退出即清除。
t23.en: Session history stays in memory, starts recording on launch and can be paused. Pre-launch clipboard content is not imported; quitting clears history.

t24.zh: 文字最多 100 条：单条 64 KiB、总计 2 MiB；图片最多 10 张：单张 8 MiB PNG、总计 32 MiB、1600 万像素上限。
t24.en: Up to 100 text entries: 64 KiB each and 2 MiB total. Up to 10 images: 8 MiB PNG each, 32 MiB total and a 16-megapixel limit.

t25.zh: 立方体外单独长按 Ctrl 1 秒唤出可拖动快捷历史，支持复制、编辑和删除；每次重新唤出回到历史列表。打开完整历史管理可搜索、多选合并。
t25.en: Hold Ctrl alone for one second outside the cube for draggable quick history: copy, edit and delete. Each invocation returns to the list. Open the full history manager for search and multi-entry merging.

t26.zh: 空白整理、大小写转换、JSON 格式化／压缩、URL 编解码均在本地预览；复制或明确保存后才写入。图片不含 OCR。
t26.en: Whitespace cleanup, case conversion, JSON formatting/minification and URL encoding/decoding are previewed locally. Write only by copying or explicitly saving; no image OCR.

t27.zh: 常用内容支持分组、收藏、搜索、结构化字段与 {{变量}} 模板。macOS 用 ⌘⇧Space，Windows 用 Ctrl+Shift+Space 唤出。
t27.en: Reusable content supports groups, favorites, search, structured fields and {{variable}} templates. Open with ⌘⇧Space on macOS or Ctrl+Shift+Space on Windows.

t28.zh: 粘贴前验证目标焦点；macOS 自动粘贴需要辅助功能授权。无法安全恢复焦点时保留复制内容，供手动粘贴。
t28.en: Target focus is verified before paste; automatic paste on macOS requires Accessibility permission. When focus cannot be safely restored, content remains copied for manual paste.

t30.zh: 静置节能暂停渲染：macOS 默认开启，Windows 默认关闭。隐藏时停止渲染；macOS 隐藏／遮挡时延后主题纹理更新。
t30.en: Idle power saving pauses rendering: enabled by default on macOS, off by default on Windows. Hidden surfaces stop rendering; macOS defers hidden/occluded theme textures.

t31.zh: 复用纹理并限制缓存；修改外观即时保存，仅重置当前外观，不影响入口和位置。
t31.en: Textures are reused and caches are bounded. Appearance changes save immediately; resetting appearance preserves launchers and position.

t32.zh: 配置导入／导出提供预览、导入前备份、恢复与失效入口重连；损坏配置保留。显示器映射独立保存，不含在启动器配置导出中。
t32.en: Configuration import/export has previews, pre-import backups, restore and broken-shortcut relinking; corrupt files are preserved. Display mappings are stored separately and excluded from launcher exports.

t33.zh: 安装版首次启动默认开启登录自启，可关闭并记住；尊重系统批准和禁用状态。
t33.en: Installed apps enable login startup by default on first launch. Opt out and the choice is remembered; system approvals and disabled states are respected.

t34.zh: 核心功能本地运行，无遥测、无云同步。手动检查或启用默认关闭的 6 小时版本提醒时访问 GitHub；公开构建经发布页手动下载安装。
t34.en: Core features run locally, with no telemetry or cloud sync. Manual checks and optional six-hour release reminders contact GitHub; reminders default off. Public builds use manual downloads from the release page.

t36.zh: 显示图标、放大 / 恢复静置
t36.en: Reveal icons and enlarge / return to rest

t42.zh: 临时恢复原大小，可配合左键拖动
t42.en: Restore resting size; combine with left drag

t46.zh: 收起展开的四图标面板

t48.zh: 核心启动和显示器检测不需要屏幕录制权限。macOS 自动粘贴需要辅助功能授权；登录自启可能需要系统批准。显示器控制还取决于硬件连接。
t48.en: Core launching and display detection do not need Screen Recording permission. Automatic paste on macOS requires Accessibility; login startup may require system approval. Display control also depends on hardware.

t49.zh: 显示器切换一定可用吗？

t50.zh: 不是。显示器需支持 DDC/CI；请用实体菜单分别切到两个输入，在当前活动主机读取代码后保存。检测到设备不代表兼容。切换后失去回读时，请用活动主机或显示器实体菜单恢复。
t50.en: No. The display must support DDC/CI. Physically select each input, read its code on the active host and save both codes. Detection does not guarantee compatibility. If readback is lost after switching, recover from the active host or physical display menu.

t51.zh: 剪贴板会保存到磁盘吗？
t51.en: Is clipboard history saved to disk?

t52.zh: 会话历史不写磁盘、不云同步，退出即清除。你明确保存到常用内容的记录会本地持久化。部分隐私排除标记会被跳过，但未标记的敏感内容仍可能被会话历史记录，可随时暂停或清空。
t52.en: Session history is never written to disk or synced; quitting clears it. Records explicitly saved to the content library persist locally. Some privacy exclusion markers are respected, but unmarked sensitive content may be recorded; pause or clear history when needed.

t54.zh: 先正常退出旧版，再安装新版本，并保留现有配置。macOS 当前为 ad-hoc 签名、未做 Developer ID 公证；Windows 安装包未做 Authenticode 签名，系统可能显示安全提示。仅从可信发布渠道下载。
t54.en: Quit the previous version normally, install the new build and keep your configuration. macOS builds are ad-hoc signed and not Developer ID notarized; Windows installers are not Authenticode signed, so system security prompts may appear. Download only from trusted release sources.

t59.zh:
应用、文件、剪贴板与灵感。
在一个通透的立方体里，轻盈连接。
t59.en:
Apps, files, your clipboard and ideas.
One clear cube. Everything within reach.

t62.zh: 为 macOS 与 Windows 而生。免费，开源。
t62.en: Made for macOS and Windows. Free and open source.

t63.zh: 真实原生渲染 · 示例图标

t64.zh: 向下，发现你的新工作台
t64.en: Scroll to meet your new workspace

t65.zh:
小小的立方。
大大的顺手。
t65.en:
A little cube.
A lot more flow.

t66.zh: 常用的东西，不必藏在层层窗口里。把六个面留给你的日常：工作、创作、浏览、整理。转一转，就在眼前。
t66.en: The things you use every day deserve a place close by. Give each face a role: work, create, browse, organize. Turn the cube. Find your flow.

t67.zh: 极光主题的原生立方体渲染
t67.en: Native cube render in the Aurora theme

t68.zh: 六个面，24 个快捷入口。

t69.zh:
把常用，
放在触手可及处。

t70.zh: 应用、文件夹、文件、网页和系统设置，都有自己的位置。拖入添加，点击打开；也可以先展开一个面，再挑选。
t70.en: Apps, folders, files, websites and system settings all have a place. Drag in a shortcut and click to open, or expand a face before choosing.

t71.zh: 网页标题随图标显示，长标题悬停可读。
t71.en: Website titles stay with their icons; hover to read long names.

t72.zh: 左键拖动移动，右键拖动或滚动旋转。
t72.en: Left-drag to move; right-drag or scroll to rotate.

t73.zh: Windows 可按名称搜索已安装应用。
t73.en: Find installed Windows apps by name.

t74.zh:
看得见的质感。
摸得到的回应。
t74.en:
Light you can see.
Motion you can feel.

t75.zh: 玻璃的通透，史莱姆的弹性。悬停即展开，移开便安静。九款主题，让每一面都合你心意。
t75.en: The clarity of glass. The elasticity of Slime. Hover to reveal; move away to quiet. Nine themes make every face your own.

t79.zh: 减少动态效果，依然从容。
t79.en: Reduced motion. The same calm focus.

t80.zh: 以上为玻璃材质原生渲染；史莱姆材质支持随指针牵引与弹性回弹。系统版本与辅助功能设置会影响材质效果。
t80.en: Native glass-material renders shown above. Slime follows the pointer with elastic rebound. Material effects vary with OS version and accessibility settings.

t81.zh:
桌面有秩序。
思路不打断。
t81.en:
A calmer desktop.
An uninterrupted thought.

t82.zh: 需要时，它就在手边。不需要时，它懂得退到一旁。
t82.en: Close when you need it. Out of the way when you don’t.

t83.en:
Less in the way.
More in the flow.

t84.zh: 贴近屏幕边缘，离开后收成一条纤细的控制柄。鼠标靠近，立方体轻柔归位。全屏时自动隐藏，位置始终记得。
t84.en: Near the display edge, leaving collapses the cube into a slender handle. Hover to bring it gently back. It hides in fullscreen and remembers its resting position.

t86.en: Recorded from the native macOS app.

t88.zh: macOS 显示器 Type-C 与 HDMI 输入切换
t88.en: Type-C and HDMI input switching on macOS

t90.zh: 从菜单栏或托盘切换 Type-C / HDMI。每台显示器保存独立的输入映射，切换结果经过回读确认。macOS 还能独立调节支持的屏幕亮度。
t90.en: Switch Type-C / HDMI from the menu bar or tray. Each monitor keeps its own input mapping, with readback to confirm a switch. On macOS, adjust supported display brightness independently.

t91.zh: 输入切换支持 macOS / Windows；外接显示器需支持 DDC/CI，首次使用请按实体菜单校准端口代码。
t91.en: Input switching supports macOS / Windows. External displays need DDC/CI; calibrate input codes using the physical display menu before first use.

t93.zh:
复制过的，
都能接着用。
t93.en:
Copied once.
Ready for what’s next.

t94.zh: 文字、图片和临时灵感，不必来回复制。一个快捷手势，让这一轮工作的上下文留在手边。
t94.en: Text, images and passing ideas, without copying them all over again. A simple gesture keeps this session’s context close.

t95.zh: macOS 剪贴板快捷历史面板，包含文字和图片记录
t95.en: macOS quick clipboard history with text and image records

t96.zh:
按住一秒。
找回刚才的灵感。
t96.en:
Hold for a second.
Pick up your last thought.

t97.zh: 在立方体外单独长按 Ctrl，快捷历史就在指针附近出现。释放后点选复制，也能编辑、删除；搜索和多选合并，请打开完整历史管理。
t97.en: Hold Ctrl alone outside the cube to open history near the pointer. Release, then click to copy, edit or delete. Use the full history manager for search and multi-entry merging.

t99.zh: 空白整理、大小写、JSON、URL 编解码，在本地完成。明确复制或保存，才会写入结果。
t99.en: Clean whitespace, change case, format JSON or encode URLs locally. A result is written only when you copy or explicitly save it.

t101.zh: 给常用文案分组、收藏，或把 {{变量}} 留给模板。预览填充结果，再复制或粘贴到验证过的目标。
t101.en: Group and favorite useful text, or leave {{variables}} in templates. Preview the filled result, then copy or paste to a verified target.

t102.zh: 原生剪贴板文字处理的可编辑预览

t103.zh: 文字处理：结果先在预览里。
t103.en: Text tools: the result starts in a preview.

t104.zh: Windows 常用内容与结构化字段管理界面
t104.en: Windows reusable content library and structured fields

t105.zh: 常用内容：文案、字段与模板各归其位。
t105.en: Reusable content: text, fields and templates, organized.

t106.zh:
轻一点。
也私密一点。
t106.en:
Lighter on your desktop.
Closer to your privacy.

t107.zh: 静置时放缓，隐藏时停止渲染。让注意力和图形资源，都留给手头的事。
t107.en: Idle power saving pauses rendering, and hidden surfaces stop drawing. Leave attention and graphics work for what you’re doing.

t108.en: The code is open. Take a look.

t109.zh: 历史留在这一轮工作里。

t110.zh: 剪贴板会话历史只保存在内存，不落盘、不云同步。退出应用，即刻清除。你主动保存到常用内容的记录另行本地持久化。
t110.en: Clipboard session history stays in memory, never on disk or in cloud sync, and clears on quit. Items you explicitly save to the content library persist locally.

t112.zh: 核心功能本地运行，无遥测。配置可预览导入导出，导入前自动备份。版本提醒默认关闭；手动检查或启用提醒时会访问 GitHub。
t112.en: Core features run locally with no telemetry. Preview configuration imports/exports and keep pre-import backups. Release reminders default off; manual checks and enabled reminders contact GitHub.

t113.zh:
每一面，
都想得更周全。

t114.zh: 从功能到边界，完整了解 T-Cube。
t114.en: Get to know the complete feature set—and its boundaries.

t116.zh: 同一颗立方体，为两种桌面系统分别打磨。
t116.en: One cube, crafted for two desktop platforms.

t118.en: A few gestures. A natural fit.

t120.zh:
给桌面，
一个新的开始。
t120.en:
Give your desktop
a new beginning.

t121.zh: T-Cube 免费开源。选好平台，即刻下载。
t121.en: Free and open source. Choose your platform and make it yours.

t126.zh: 本地 ad-hoc 签名，未 Developer ID 公证。
t126.en: Ad-hoc signed. Not Developer ID notarized.

t127.zh: 熟悉的桌面，多一种可能。
t127.en: A familiar desktop. A new possibility.

t130.zh: 自带运行环境，未 Authenticode 签名。

t131.zh: 升级前请先退出旧版，并保留现有配置。系统可能显示安全提示。
t131.en: Quit the previous version before upgrading and preserve your configuration. System security prompts may appear.

t135.zh:
还有这些，
你可能想知道。
t135.en:
A few more things
worth knowing.

t138.zh: 产品图为真实原生渲染与界面截图，含示例图标。
t138.en: Product images are native renders and actual UI captures, with sample icons.
